summary_en: Kioxia declared its first dividend of 90 yen per share (pre-split basis) as an interim dividend with a record date of September 30, 2026, totaling 47.9 billion yen. The company adopted a shareholder return policy targeting 100% payout of surplus cash after funding capex, R&D, human capital investment, and strategic M&A, with progressive dividends and opportunistic buybacks as core methods.
title_en: Notice Regarding Shareholder Return Policy and Dividend Distribution (Interim Dividend and Initial Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
Kioxia Holdings announced its first dividend distribution on October 30, 2026, following its public listing. The company declared an interim dividend of 90 yen per share on a pre-split basis with a record date of September 30, 2026, resulting in a total dividend payment of 47.9 billion yen. The dividend will take effect on December 8, 2026, and will be paid from retained earnings.

The company adopted a comprehensive shareholder return policy reflecting improved business performance driven by expanded AI-related demand and strengthened cash flow generation. Under this policy, after funding capital expenditures, research and development, human capital investments, strategic initiatives including M&A, and other committed future cash outflows while maintaining a net cash position, the company commits to allocate 100% of surplus cash to shareholder returns on a medium to long-term basis. Progressive dividends and opportunistic share buybacks are established as core methods for returning capital.

In August 2026, the company had already executed a share repurchase program as part of implementing this new capital allocation framework. The announced dividend, combined with the earlier buyback, demonstrates management's confidence in the sustainability of improved financial performance and commitment to enhancing shareholder value.
